newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AMERICA, ASIA BOOST HUNTER DOUGLAS Q1 SALES.
newsitem.headline: AMERICA, ASIA BOOST HUNTER DOUGLAS Q1 SALES.

text.p: Window blinds maker Hunter Douglas said on Tuesday first-quarter sales were boosted by strong growth in North and Latin America and Asia.
"Sales in North America, Latin America and Asia continued their strong growth," the company said in a statement, adding sales in Europe were flat, while Australian sales declined.
The company earlier reported first-quarter turnover up 13.4 percent at 570 million guilders.
It said sales volume accounted for 3.5 percent of the increase, acquisitions for 2.2 percent and currency differences for 7.7 percent.
